commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.n.en: Can't run the census: this world has no Hoanna, or the Inquisitorium Outpost structure set was removed by a data pack.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.n.zh: 量不了：这个世界没有海纳尔，或者数据包删掉了审判庭前哨的结构集。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.h.en: Shadow census, seed %s: %s × %s chunks, one sample every %s chunks (%s samples, %s ms).
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.h.zh: 暗影区普查，种子 %s：%s × %s 区块，每 %s 区块采一点（%s 个点，%s 毫秒）。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.p.en: %s patches of Shadow Corrupted Land; at least %s chunks: %s patches, %s chunks in all. Patch size: median %s, 90%% under %s, largest %s chunks.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.p.zh: 暗影腐化之地 %s 片；不小于 %s 区块的 %s 片，合计 %s 区块。每片大小：中位 %s，九成不到 %s，最大 %s 区块。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.t.en: Too many samples: these settings need %s, at most %s are allowed (it runs on the server thread). Use a smaller size or a larger step.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.t.zh: 点数太多：这组参数要采 %s 个点，最多 %s 个（在服务器主线程上跑）。把边长调小或者步长调大。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.o.en: Outposts at %s / %s: %s predicted (%s candidates, %s in the right biome, %s%% ruled out near towns or vaults, %s off any patch). Large patches hold %s each on average; %s%% hold none.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_census.o.zh: 前哨（%s / %s）：预测 %s 座（候选 %s 个，群系对的 %s 个，%s%% 因为离城镇 / 宝库太近没放，%s 座没归到哪一片）。大片平均每片 %s 座，%s%% 一座都没有。
